sections.Profile:
The "Sea Side" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1967, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Ed Krynski, with artwork by Art Stenholm. This machine, produced for export to Italy, is an "add-a-ball" version of Gottlieb's "Surf Side."

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Boats, Water Sports, Two player, Women, Good Times, Sailing, Ocean, Original Theme
